Text: WHEN the POS sends a completed purchase event, the loyalty service shall create a pending points transaction for the member.
WHEN the customer mobile app requests a balance, the loyalty service shall return the customer's points balance.
Rationale: Members check their balance after paying.

Text: The loyalty service shall show the account holder the history of points transactions of their account.
WHEN a member deletes their account in the customer mobile app, the loyalty service shall keep the member's points transactions for audit.
WHEN the loyalty service issues a voucher, the loyalty service shall set the voucher value to SGD 1 per 100 redeemed points.
